# FLOW

FLOW defines portable workflow packages and finite process contracts.

- Landing page: https://flow.jig.md/
- Specification map: https://flow.jig.md/guide/
- Package/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/package-format
- Run/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/run-protocol
- Run SDK/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/run-sdk
- Schema/1: https://flow.jig.md/spec/schema-files
- Machine schemas: https://flow.jig.md/schemas/schema-1.json
- Source and conformance: https://github.com/jigmd/jig
- Jig host: https://jig.md/
